description: Produce two audit documents: (1) Notification Architecture Audit explaining which notifications work for in-app vs push vs socket events (Follow, Like, Save). (2) Post Publishing Pipeline Audit tracing media from picker to rendering, identifying where data could be lost.
steps: 1. Create .agents/tasks/task-final-qa-round/NOTIFICATION_AUDIT.md documenting: (a) Follow notifications: in-app created via notification.service.js createNotification({type:'Follow'}), push sent via pushServiceSend if user has tokens and push prefs enabled, socket event NOTIFICATION_COUNT_CHANGED emitted to recipient. (b) Like notifications: same flow with type 'Like', but deduplicates (findOneAndUpdate). Re-likes do NOT re-trigger push. (c) Save notifications: same as Like with type 'Save', same dedup behavior. (d) Summary table: Type | In-App | Push | Socket | Notes.

2. Create .agents/tasks/task-final-qa-round/POST_PIPELINE_AUDIT.md documenting the 7-stage pipeline: Stage 1 (Media Picker): CreateScreen uses ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync with allowsMultipleSelection:true, selectionLimit: Math.max(1, 6 - mediaItems.length). MAX_IMAGES=5, MAX_VIDEOS=1. Stage 2 (FormData Construction): All items in mediaItems array are appended as formData.append('media', ...) in a loop. Stage 3 (Multer): secureUpload.array('media', 6) - accepts up to 6 files in memory. Stage 4 (Cloudinary): post.controller.js maps over req.files and uploads each buffer to Cloudinary. Stage 5 (MongoDB): post.media array stores ALL uploaded media objects (url, providerId, type). Stage 6 (GET API): getSinglePost returns full post document including ALL media items. getFeed also returns full media array. Stage 7 (Rendering): PostCard uses FlatList with data={post.media} - renders ALL items as swipeable pages. PostDetailScreen same - FlatList horizontal paginated with data={post.media}.

3. In the POST_PIPELINE_AUDIT.md, include the VERDICT: No media loss at any stage. The pipeline correctly handles multiple media items end-to-end. If the user reports seeing only 1 image in Post Detail, the issue is likely: (a) the post was created before the multi-media fix was deployed, (b) the initial scroll position hides other items (but pagination dots should show), (c) a specific device rendering issue. Profile grid and Explore grid intentionally show only the FIRST image (using getPrimaryImageUrl helper) which is by design for grid thumbnails.
4. Include evidence references for each stage (file paths and line numbers).
acceptance_criteria: NOTIFICATION_AUDIT.md exists with clear documentation of Follow/Like/Save notification flows
Each stage references specific file paths and code patterns
Clear verdict on where (if anywhere) media could be lost
verification: Read both audit documents and confirm they reference actual code paths
Verify the pipeline stages match the actual code flow
findings: Both audit documents created successfully. Notification audit covers Follow/Like/Save/Comment with dedup behavior and preference checks. Post pipeline audit confirms NO media loss at any of the 7 stages. Profile and Explore grids show only first image by design.
